_comment: Starter advice for PlantVillage tomato, potato and maize classes. yield_impact values are rough planning placeholders, NOT measured figures: review every entry with an extension officer or KALRO guide before the pilot.

en: The model is not sure about this photo.
Take a clearer photo of one leaf in daylight, or show the plant to an agricultural extension officer.
sw: Mfumo hauna uhakika kuhusu picha hii.
Piga picha nyingine ya jani moja mchana, au mwonyeshe afisa wa ugani wa kilimo.

en: The plant looks healthy.
Keep checking leaves weekly and remove any that show spots.
sw: Mmea unaonekana kuwa na afya.
Endelea kukagua majani kila wiki na uondoe yenye madoa.

en: No treatment advice is stored for this disease yet. Please consult an extension officer.
sw: Bado hakuna ushauri wa tiba kwa ugonjwa huu. Tafadhali wasiliana na afisa wa ugani.

en: Remove and destroy infected leaves and plants.
Avoid wetting leaves; water at the base.
Spray a recommended fungicide as advised by an agro-dealer or extension officer.
sw: Ondoa na uharibu majani na mimea iliyoathirika.
Usimwagie majani maji; mwagilia kwenye shina.
Nyunyizia dawa ya kuvu inayopendekezwa na muuzaji wa pembejeo au afisa wa ugani.

en: Remove lower infected leaves.
Rotate crops; do not plant tomatoes or potatoes in the same place next season.
Use a recommended fungicide if spots spread.
sw: Ondoa majani ya chini yaliyoathirika.
Badilisha mazao; usipande nyanya au viazi mahali pamoja msimu ujao.
Tumia dawa ya kuvu inayopendekezwa madoa yakienea.

en: Remove infected leaves and avoid working with wet plants.
Use certified disease-free seed next season.
Ask an extension officer about copper-based sprays.
sw: Ondoa majani yaliyoathirika na usishughulikie mimea ikiwa na unyevu.
Tumia mbegu zilizothibitishwa msimu ujao.
Uliza afisa wa ugani kuhusu dawa zenye shaba.

en: Improve air flow by pruning and spacing plants.
Reduce humidity, especially in greenhouses.
Remove affected leaves.
sw: Ongeza mzunguko wa hewa kwa kupogoa na kuachanisha mimea.
Punguza unyevu, hasa kwenye vitalu nyumba.
Ondoa majani yaliyoathirika.

en: Remove spotted lower leaves.
Mulch to stop soil splashing onto leaves.
Use a recommended fungicide if it spreads.
sw: Ondoa majani ya chini yenye madoa.
Weka matandazo kuzuia udongo kurukia majani.
Tumia dawa ya kuvu inayopendekezwa ukienea.

en: Spray leaves (especially undersides) with clean water.
Ask an agro-dealer for a recommended miticide if damage continues.
sw: Nyunyizia majani maji safi, hasa upande wa chini.
Uliza muuzaji wa pembejeo dawa ya utitiri ikiwa uharibifu unaendelea.

en: Remove infected leaves and plant debris.
Improve spacing for air flow.
Use a recommended fungicide if needed.
sw: Ondoa majani na mabaki ya mimea yaliyoathirika.
Ongeza nafasi kati ya mimea.
Tumia dawa ya kuvu inayopendekezwa ikihitajika.

en: Uproot and destroy infected plants; the virus cannot be cured.
Control whiteflies, which spread the virus.
Plant tolerant varieties next season.
sw: Ng'oa na uharibu mimea iliyoathirika; virusi havitibiki.
Dhibiti inzi weupe wanaoeneza virusi.
Panda aina zinazostahimili msimu ujao.

en: Remove infected plants.
Wash hands and tools after handling plants.
Use clean, certified seed.
sw: Ondoa mimea iliyoathirika.
Osha mikono na vifaa baada ya kushika mimea.
Tumia mbegu safi zilizothibitishwa.

en: Remove and destroy infected plants quickly.
Spray a recommended fungicide during wet weather.
Harvest early if the disease spreads and store only healthy tubers.
sw: Ondoa na uharibu mimea iliyoathirika haraka.
Nyunyizia dawa ya kuvu inayopendekezwa wakati wa mvua.
Vuna mapema ugonjwa ukienea na uhifadhi viazi vyenye afya pekee.

en: Remove infected leaves.
Rotate crops and keep plants well fed.
Use a recommended fungicide if spots spread.
sw: Ondoa majani yaliyoathirika.
Badilisha mazao na lisha mimea vizuri.
Tumia dawa ya kuvu inayopendekezwa madoa yakienea.

en: Plant resistant maize varieties next season.
Ask an extension officer whether spraying is worthwhile for your field.
sw: Panda aina za mahindi zinazostahimili msimu ujao.
Uliza afisa wa ugani kama kunyunyizia dawa kunafaa shambani kwako.

en: Rotate maize with legumes such as beans.
Bury or remove crop residue after harvest.
Plant resistant varieties.
sw: Badilisha mahindi na mikunde kama maharagwe.
Fukia au ondoa mabaki ya mazao baada ya kuvuna.
Panda aina zinazostahimili.

en: Rotate crops and remove residue.
Plant resistant varieties.
Consult an extension officer about fungicides.
sw: Badilisha mazao na ondoa mabaki.
Panda aina zinazostahimili.
Wasiliana na afisa wa ugani kuhusu dawa za kuvu.
